item.title: Box office report: Do Deewane Seher Mein, Assi see lukewarm growth
item.description: O’ Romeo continues its strong run at the box office, crossing Rs 55 crore in India, while Do Deewane Seher Mein and Assi struggle to gain momentum. Tu Yaa Main remains modest. Here’s the complete weekend box office collection breakdown.

item.description: N. Seshagiri Rao (72), Radha Krishnamurthy (74) of Lalacheruvu, Chowdeshwari Nagar have died on Monday morning while undergoing treatment.

item.title: Homemade, organic pesticides for plants at home that protects your garden
item.description: Tiny holes in leaves, sticky residue, and sudden plant damage can quickly turn your healthy garden into a struggle. Choosing the right solution makes all the difference in protecting your plants and keeping them thriving. Keep reading to know some DIY pesticide that would work wonders for your home gardens.

item.title: From construction sites to hospital rooms: Where does aspergillus come from
item.description: Aspergillus spores are widespread in the environment. Air currents carry them and can be detected in dust and soil in both indoor and outdoor settings. While spores may be present even in dry environments, active growth of Aspergillus is more likely in areas with moisture and organic material.

item.title: Two policemen found murdered near India-Pak border; Bishnoi gang vows violent revenge
item.description: Tension has escalated in Punjab after the killing of two officers in Gurdaspur, as an alleged social media post linked to the Lawrence Bishnoi gang threatened violent retaliation while police continue their probe.

item.title: Ola electric plans to cut store network to 550
item.description: Ola Electric is set to reduce its physical outlets to around 550 by March amid slowing demand, falling sales and declining market share. The company has already shut hundreds of stores and announced job cuts as part of a broader restructuring plan.

item.title: Uttarakhand cabinet minister Rekha Arya faces nearly Rs 3 lakh in unpaid electricity bills, sparks debate
item.description: Uttarakhand’s Energy Corporation has released a list of major electricity bill defaulters, naming Cabinet Minister Rekha Arya and late minister Chandan Ramdas. Rekha Arya reportedly owes nearly Rs 3 lakh, while Ramdas’s dues stand at about Rs 2.85 lakh, sparking public debate.

item.title: iPhone exports from India double in 2025 as Apple takes 76% of smartphone shipments
item.description: Apple’s iPhone exports from India rose sharply in 2025, with HS code data pointing to about $23 billion in shipments, mainly to the US. Smartphones also became India’s top export category for the year.

item.title: ‘There should be sense of dignity, responsibility’: Veteran Congress leader Margaret Alva on shirtless protests at AI Summit
item.description: Congress leader Margaret Alva joined a long list of political leaders criticising the Congress Party over the recent shirtless protests at the AI Summit in Delhi. She called out the act, saying that there was a need to maintain dignity at international events and the party needed to act responsibly.
